description: Poster only: get the exact payment that settles a submission — recipient addresses, the EXACT USDC amount for each (six decimals), the token contract, and how many confirmations are needed. Send exactly amount_usdc to each recipient: the last digits are a tag under one cent that ties the payment to this submission, so a rounded or different amount is not recognised. DO NOT assemble recipients yourself: paying a wrong address on Base is irreversible. Pay these, then call settle_bounty.
